description: Synthesises multilingual speech from text using any of 21 named voices or a custom voice_id (ElevenLabs).

prompt.description: The text to convert to speech.

apply_text_normalization.description: Text normalization mode. 'auto' lets the system decide, 'on' always applies normalization, 'off' skips it.

language_code.description: ISO-639-1 or ISO-639-3 language code (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'fra'). Leave empty for automatic detection.

similarity_boost.description: Similarity boost. Higher values make the voice more similar to the original.

speed.description: Speech speed. 1.0 is normal, <1.0 slower, >1.0 faster.

stability.description: Voice stability. Lower values give broader emotional range, higher values produce more consistent but potentially monotonous speech.

style.description: Style exaggeration. Higher values increase stylistic expression but may reduce stability. Only honored for eleven_multilingual_v2.

use_speaker_boost.description: Boost similarity to the original speaker voice. Only honored for eleven_multilingual_v2.

voice.description: Voice ID to use for speech synthesis. Pass a Voice Selector friendly key resolved via ELEVENLABS_VOICE_CODES, or a custom voice_id (e.g. from Instant Voice Clone). Available voices: Roger (male, american); Sarah (female, american); Laura (female, american); Charlie (male, australian); George (male, british); Callum (male, american); River (neutral, american); Harry (male, american); Liam (male, american); Alice (female, british); Matilda (female, american); Will (male, american); Jessica (female, american); Eric (male, american); Bella (female, american); Chris (male, american); Brian (male, american); Daniel (male, british); Lily (female, british); Adam (male, american); Bill (male, american).
